question: How many players are there on each side?
gold_anchors: each of eleven players
expected_answer: 11 players, one of whom is captain.

question: How many substitute fielders can a captain nominate?
gold_anchors: maximum of 4 substitute fielders
expected_answer: Up to 4 substitute fielders (plus the 11 players).

question: What is the minimum over rate to be achieved in a match?
gold_anchors: shall be 14.11 overs per hour
expected_answer: 14.11 overs per hour.

question: How many overs can one bowler bowl in an innings?
gold_anchors: No bowler shall bowl more than 4 overs
expected_answer: 4 overs.

question: How long can the pitch be rolled before the start of the second innings?
gold_anchors: for a period of not more than
expected_answer: Up to 7 minutes, at the request of the captain of the side batting second.

question: How many unsuccessful player review requests is each team allowed per innings?
gold_anchors: maximum of two Player Review requests
expected_answer: 2 unsuccessful reviews per innings.

question: For how many overs do the Powerplay fielding restrictions apply?
gold_anchors: first 6 overs of each innings
expected_answer: The first 6 overs of each innings (uninterrupted match).

question: How many fast short-pitched deliveries can a bowler bowl in an over?
gold_anchors: limited to one fast short-pitched delivery per over
expected_answer: 1 per over.

question: What is the minimum distance from the boundary rope to the first solid object?
gold_anchors: 3 yards (2.74 meters) from the boundary rope
expected_answer: 3 yards (2.74 m).

question: How long is the interval between innings?
gold_anchors: separated by a 20-minute interval between innings
expected_answer: 20 minutes.

question: Can the groundsman flatten the wicket at the innings break?
gold_anchors: for a period of not more than
expected_answer: Yes, it can be rolled for up to 7 minutes before the second innings if the captain batting second asks.

question: If the ball hits the pad but was going over the stumps, is it out?
gold_anchors: but for the interception, the ball would have hit the wicket
expected_answer: Not out LBW: the ball must have gone on to hit the wicket.

question: What happens if a fielder pretends to throw the ball to trick the batter?
gold_anchors: Deliberate distraction, deception or obstruction of batter 41.5.1 || 41.5.6 The bowler’s end umpire shall
expected_answer: Dead ball, no batter can be out, 5 penalty runs to the batting side, and the ball doesn't count in the over.

question: What happens if the bowler gets hurt halfway through an over?
gold_anchors: Bowler incapacitated or suspended during an over
expected_answer: Dead ball; another bowler finishes the over from the same end (not someone who bowled the previous over).

question: How quickly does the fielding team have to start the next over?
gold_anchors: within 60 seconds of the previous over
expected_answer: Within 60 seconds (stop clock).

question: Where can the fielding team leave their spare helmets on the field?
gold_anchors: may not be placed on the ground, above the surface except behind the wicket-keeper
expected_answer: Only on the ground behind the wicket-keeper, in line with both sets of stumps.

question: What happens if it gets too dark or wet to keep playing?
gold_anchors: they shall immediately suspend play
expected_answer: If the umpires agree conditions are dangerous or unreasonable, they suspend play (or don't let it start).

question: How long does a new batter have to get ready after a wicket falls?
gold_anchors: within 1 minute 30 seconds of the dismissal
expected_answer: 1 minute 30 seconds, otherwise out Timed out.

question: If the bowling side messes with the ball, who picks the replacement ball?
gold_anchors: the batter at the wicket shall choose the replacement ball
expected_answer: The batter picks it from six other balls of varying wear.

question: How many drinks breaks are there if the innings is cut to 15 overs before it starts?
gold_anchors: reduced at outset to between 15 and 19 overs, two drinks breaks
expected_answer: Two drinks breaks.

question: If the bowler oversteps the line and the batter skies it straight to a fielder, is he out?
gold_anchors: Out from a No ball When No ball has been called
expected_answer: No. Off a no ball a batter can only be out hit the ball twice, obstructing the field or run out.

question: If the ball is way down the leg side and the keeper whips the bails off while the batter is out of his crease, is he out?
gold_anchors: Out from a Wide When Wide ball has been called
expected_answer: Yes. Off a wide a batter can be out hit wicket, obstructing the field, run out or stumped.

question: Can a concussed player be replaced by someone who isn't on the nominated list?
gold_anchors: Under exceptional circumstances, the match referee will consider a request
expected_answer: Normally no, but in exceptional circumstances the match referee will consider it.

question: Rain holds up the start just after the toss. Can the team batting first get the roller on?
gold_anchors: Rolling after a delayed start
expected_answer: Yes, for up to 7 minutes, unless the umpires agree the delay had no significant effect on the pitch.

question: Is there a follow-on in a T20 match?
gold_anchors: §14 The Follow-on
expected_answer: No, the follow-on does not apply.

question: If the batters turn back halfway through a run, do they get penalised for running short?
gold_anchors: Batters may choose to abort a run
expected_answer: Yes, as long as the umpire believes there was no intent to deceive.

question: Does a game between India and an associate nation like Nepal still need the full camera setup for reviews?
gold_anchors: shall not apply for matches between a Full Member country and Associate
expected_answer: No, those requirements don't apply to Full Member vs Associate matches.

question: Can the non-striker try to sneak a run while the bowler is running in?
gold_anchors: It is unfair for the batters to attempt to steal a run
expected_answer: No. Dead ball, batters sent back, run disallowed, 5 penalty runs to the fielding side (unless the bowler tries a run out).

question: If a spinner's full toss reaches the batter above the hip without bouncing, is it a no ball even though it isn't dangerous?
gold_anchors: whether or not it is likely to inflict physical injury
expected_answer: No. Any non-pitching ball above waist height is a no ball, dangerous or not.

question: If ball-tracking shows the ball just clipping the stumps and the not-out decision stands, does the team lose their review?
gold_anchors: shall not count towards the innings limit set out in paragraph 3.6.1
expected_answer: No. It's 'Unchanged - Umpire's Call' and doesn't count towards the limit.

question: In the practice games before the tournament, can all 15 squad members bat?
gold_anchors: No more than 11 may bat in one innings
expected_answer: No. Up to 15 can be nominated, but no more than 11 may bat in one innings.

question: Who deals with player misbehaviour in the practice games before the tournament?
gold_anchors: ICC Match Referees will not be on duty for warm-up matches
expected_answer: The Event Technical Committee. The Code of Conduct applies, but match referees aren't on duty.

question: If the tie-breaker over is also level, can the guy who bowled it bowl the next one too?
gold_anchors: shall be ineligible to bowl in the subsequent Super Over
expected_answer: No, a bowler from the previous Super Over can't bowl in the next one.

question: In the one-over eliminator, if a team already used up both its reviews in the match, can it still review?
gold_anchors: one unsuccessful player review per innings per Super Over
expected_answer: Yes. Each team gets one unsuccessful review per innings per Super Over, regardless of reviews used in the match.

question: In a 7-overs-a-side rain game, what's the most a single bowler can send down?
gold_anchors: between 5 and 9 overs, no bowler may bowl more than two overs
expected_answer: 2 overs.

question: What time does the final start if it goes to the reserve day?
gold_anchors: Final on 9 March

question: If rain hits the final, what's the shortest chase that still gives a result?
gold_anchors: For the semi-finals and final, a minimum of 10 overs
expected_answer: The team batting second must face at least 10 overs (5 in other matches).

question: On a free hit that is called wide, can the batter be out stumped?
gold_anchors: For any free hit, the striker can be dismissed only under the circumstances that apply for a No ball || Out from a No ball When No ball has been called
expected_answer: No. On a free hit only no-ball modes apply (hit twice, obstructing, run out), even if it's called wide.

question: For the tie-breaking over, can the bowling side ask for a fresh, unused ball?
gold_anchors: but no new balls
expected_answer: No. They choose from the spare balls box, which has the match balls but no new balls.

question: If a knockout game gets rained off halfway through, do they replay it from scratch the next day?
gold_anchors: the match will resume on the reserve day at the point where the last ball was played
expected_answer: No. It resumes on the reserve day from the point where the last ball was played.
